facts.fact: MHRSD announced on 4 January 2026 an increase in Saudization rates for engineering roles. Law-firm and advisory alerts report a 30% quota for private establishments employing five or more engineers, effective 30 June 2026. Only engineers with a recognised engineering bachelor's degree and valid Saudi Council of Engineers registration count toward the quota.
facts.caveat: Primary MHRSD text not retrieved. One alert cites a SAR 8,000 minimum salary for counting; not confirmed by a second source.
facts.implication: If you are a Saudi national, SCE registration after graduation makes you count toward employers' quotas, which strengthens entry-level demand.

facts.fact: From 21 July 2024 the engineering Saudization ratio was 25% for private entities with at least five engineers; only SCE-certified engineers count.

Classification follows a sequential process based on qualifications, experience, professional exams and professional development (Associate, Professional, Consultant grades). Registration for applicants with under five years of experience is not accepted unless they are Saudi.
facts.caveat: SCE site returned 503 / did not load during research; details are from search excerpts of SCE pages. Confirm the current rules on saudieng.sa.
facts.implication: Plan to register with SCE immediately after graduation; many adverts and the Saudization quota depend on it.

facts.topic: Tamheer eligibility (as stated in live adverts)
facts.fact: Tamheer adverts in this database require applicants to be graduates eligible for Tamheer, not registered with the social insurance authority (GOSI) in the past six months, and not previous Tamheer beneficiaries.
facts.caveat: HRDF's own rules page was not retrieved. Confirm on hrdf.org.sa.
facts.implication: Your part-time JNH role and TalMal internship may affect Tamheer eligibility for six months after they end.

facts.fact: For Saudi students whose university requires at least 8 weeks of practical training, not yet graduated, GPA 2.00/4 (technical). Orientation 17 January 2027, start 18 January 2027. Registration closed on 2026-11-05 with the window 'to be announced later'.
facts.caveat: Dates subject to change per Aramco.
facts.implication: Directly relevant if IMSIU requires co-op in your final term.

facts.fact: In February 2026 SAMI announced two new specialised companies, SAMI Land and SAMI Autonomous, and a land industrial complex expected to create more than 1,000 skilled jobs for Saudi nationals.
facts.implication: SAMI Autonomous is the most direct defence-UAV employer to target.

facts.fact: Space Academy published its H2 2026 training guide (courses for final-year students and recent graduates). SARI 2 (with Aramco Digital) launched 5 May 2026 for undergraduate satellite teams.
facts.implication: Your Team SIRAJ (SARI-II) role is a talking point with SSA and space-related employers.

facts.fact: Major 2026 graduate programs (PIF GDP, KAPSARC GDP, Qiddiya GDP, Misk x Tuwaiq) opened between June and July 2026 and are closed as of November 2026.
facts.implication: Set reminders for May to July 2027 for the next GDP cycle; you will have graduated by then.

salaryNote: No verified salary statistics are included. One aggregator (ERI) estimate for 'UAV Test Engineer, Riyadh' was seen but it is a modelled estimate, not market data, so it is not shown as a statistic.
